title: ASTRAEA: Grammar-based Fairness Testing
findings: The paper found that coreference resolution models exhibited significant bias based on religious identifiers. For instance, swapping 'Christian' for 'Hindu' caused a model to fail its coreference task. Across 3 models, these religious bias tests resulted in a 17% fairness violation rate.
